facts: Lexical and semantic branches are launched with async before either is awaited.
Each source is wrapped independently, and only two failures produce Error.
Lexical titles are deduplicated before lexical and semantic lists are combined.
Empty query returns a successful empty list without HTTP calls.
Lexical-semantic and semantic-lexical groups render in different orders.
The semantic HTTP endpoint is an external leaf boundary.
Feedback maps choice, title, position and query.
Opt-out persists the preference and returns to standard search.

externalLeaves.name: lexical HTTP
externalLeaves.policy: controlled response/failure/held completion only; execute application prefix/full-text fallback and dedup body

externalLeaves.name: semantic HTTP
externalLeaves.policy: controlled response/failure/held completion only; execute application semantic mapping and merge body

externalLeaves.name: analytics transport
externalLeaves.policy: controlled sink after page-owned feedback mapping executes
